settings.title: Access from a tablet
settings.hint: Browse and edit your campaigns from a tablet or phone on the same Wi-Fi as this PC. Each device must be authorized once, with a code shown here.
settings.enable: Allow access from the local network
settings.firewallNote: Once access is on, DM Loremind checks that the Windows firewall and your network type let the tablet through, and helps you fix it if needed. Only turn it on at home, never on public Wi-Fi.
settings.addressTitle: Address to open on the tablet
settings.noAddress: No local network address found: check that this PC is connected to your Wi-Fi or home router.
settings.pairSteps: On the tablet, scan the QR code, or open the address above and enter this code:
settings.qrAlt: QR code to connect the tablet
settings.expiresIn: Valid for {{time}} more, for a single device
settings.codeError: Unable to create a pairing code.
settings.revokeMessage: "{{name}}" will no longer be able to access DM Loremind. A new code will be needed to reconnect it.
settings.revokeError: Unable to remove this device's access.
settings.outsideNote: To reach it away from home (on 4G, at a friend's), the documentation explains how to use Tailscale, a free encrypted private network. Don't open this port to the Internet on your router.
settings.onDevice: You are connected from a tablet: settings can only be changed on the PC where DM Loremind is installed.

pair.title: Connect this device
pair.text: On the PC, open Settings > Access from a tablet, then "Connect a device". Enter the 6-digit code shown there.
pair.nameHint: To recognize it in the list of authorized devices.
pair.rejected: Code rejected: check it, or show a new code on the PC.
pair.failed: Connection failed. Check that the PC is on and on the same network.
pair.onHostText: This page is for connecting a tablet. On this PC, access is managed from Settings.

network.title: Network check
network.ready: The firewall and the network let the tablet through.
network.publicProblem: Windows considers your network "{{names}}" public: it blocks other devices, even with the firewall permission.
network.publicHowTo: If it's your home network, switch it to "Private": Windows network settings > your Wi-Fi > Properties > Network profile type: Private. Then check again.
network.firewallMissing: The Windows firewall doesn't let DM Loremind through yet: the tablet would load forever.
network.firewallBlocked: The Windows firewall blocks DM Loremind (a permission was probably declined).
network.uacNote: Windows will ask for administrator confirmation. DM Loremind will be allowed on private networks only.

fix.APPLIED: Done: DM Loremind is allowed through the firewall.
fix.FAILED: The permission failed. You can try again, or add it manually (see the documentation).
fix.UNSUPPORTED: This check is only available on Windows.

network.windowsReady: The Windows firewall and the network type let the tablet through.
network.thirdParty: {{names}} also filters connections on this PC, with its own rules that DM Loremind can't check. Until it allows it, the tablet will load forever.
network.thirdPartyHowTo: In that software's firewall settings: classify your Wi-Fi as a home network (not public, stealth mode off), then add a rule allowing incoming connections for DM Loremind.
network.linuxNone: No ufw or firewalld firewall is active on this machine: nothing to open.
network.linuxClosed: The firewall ({{fw}}) blocks port {{port}}: other devices would load forever. Open it with this command on the machine:
network.linuxUnknown: The {{fw}} firewall is active. DM Loremind can't read its rules without administrator rights: if you haven't already, open port {{port}} with this command on the machine:
